# Interactive sync prompts before clobbering local edits — the Ruby client
# silently destroyed them. Declining keeps the edits (exit 1: the sync is
# incomplete); accepting overwrites.

env FULCRUM_FORCE_TTY=1
fulcrum sync
cp edited.json skills/estimation-rubric.json

fulcrum -code 1 -in decline.txt sync
grep 'overwrite' last-stdout.txt
grep 'kept your local edits' last-stdout.txt
cmp skills/estimation-rubric.json edited.json

fulcrum -in accept.txt sync
cmp skills/estimation-rubric.json $CORPUS/documents/estimation-rubric.json

-- edited.json --
{
  "rubric_id": "org-default",
  "status": "edited-locally"
}
-- decline.txt --
n
-- accept.txt --
y
